about: People's verification of cases in data/forensics/cases.json (scripts/forensic-cases.py), keyed by caseId. Edited by hand. status: candidate | source_verified (checked against the original Retail ID card or certificate) | externally_confirmed (an official record says so) | dismissed (judged benign). There is no status for misconduct: a case records that identities differ, not why. checked lists what was read, when, and the SHA-256 of the bytes received, so the check can be repeated and compared.

FX-792EF427C5.by: Claude Code session for the repository owner (automated check against the original Retail ID cards; not a legal or regulatory review)
FX-792EF427C5.note: Metrc batch 1A41203000026BA000000042 is sold as Blue Dream and as Gelato 41. Package …823 (Blue Dream, product SCC350; manufacturer Pierre McClain LLC OCM-MICR-25-000246-P1; facility Harlem Blossoms LLC OCM-MICR-24-000040-DX1; packaged 2026-04-06) was made from 26BA…041, which has no public card (404). Packages …582 and …586 (Gelato 41, product SCC350-G41; Harlem Blossoms LLC; packaged 2026-05-27 and 2026-05-28) name …823 as their source package: the name changed when the Blue Dream package was repacked. All three carry one certificate: Keystone State Testing (OCM-CPL-24-00007-L1), tested 2025-12-22, THC 24.16%, eleven identical analytes; TestPassed; none on recall. The equal chemistry is that one certificate shown on each card, not an independent match. Open lead: Good Money's 'Zowah' (THC 24.16, 5 shops) cites coa/37885.pdf, a saved Retail ID page printed without its package block, so its package is not identified. Not established: which name is the plant's, or whether any rule was broken.
